purpose: diagnostic game-thread off-CPU boundaries and same-binary observer screening; not release acceptance
root_scope: new literal output root under ~/MacioGalaxy2-gamedata/port53/m1g/solb; exact path pending schedule

ownership.cache_pair: private root + owned Metal namespace initialized per pair, preserved exactly prime -> second; no intervening app/cache access

sequence: four independent prime/second pairs, history OFF ON ON OFF; same exact perf binary/resources in all eight arms

per_arm_environment.PETARI_GAME_WAIT_HISTORY_FILE: absent OFF / unique new absolute arm/game-wait.jsonl ON
per_arm_environment.PETARI_CACHE_DIR: same pair-owned private cache for prime and second

environment_policy: allowlist experiment settings, remove inherited history/GPU trace/probe/script/replay/toggle variables; record explicit values and absences; defaults identical

process.detached: bash + nohup + setsid/double-fork; verify driver/app PIDs, nice 0
process.locks: per individual arm lockf -k m1-heavy then native; no outer cohort lock, but exclusive scheduled cohort with no foreign build/app in gaps
process.quiet: load1 and load5 <=8, no active native build/app, each Metal compiler CPU delta <0.05 s over 10s; bounded wait <=900 s/arm; retain every sample; camera retained
process.quit: native TitleObservation only; no key/pointer/AX/AppleEvent quit; abnormal/timeout is failure, no replacement

trigger.phase: matched RETRACE_DONE -> END_FRAME, exact native steady ns and calling-thread CPU
trigger.near_miss: every matched phase >50ms which is not a trigger: exactly one summary, no window

reports.full_lifetime: all summaries/windows, all CoreAudio positive lines/reports and their exposure; never trim to improve a verdict
reports.comparison: prime fixed300 and warm fixed855 frame windows, separate strata; explicit native clock mapping and crossing-row policy, no cumulative rounded-time causal join
metrics: available whole-frame main/render CPU per frame, game_work/retrace/draw_done/token/pipeline/capture/API spans
main-loop/splash/graphics preparation completion and post100 compile-free pacing (existing tier m1 scorer)
audio total reports, positive reports, every positive line and total underrun frames, printed report-window exposure
trigger/near-miss counts and rates per minute matched phase exposure ON; OFF matched CPU phase metric unavailable
writer bytes/windows/work brackets, dropped/invalid/filtered/coverage counters, VM/run-state/window samples
reports.neutrality: descriptive paired and pooled OFF/ON deltas incl tails/audio; no automatic neutral PASS or causal verdict; PORT review before further capture

stop_rules: no launch without all pending bindings, PORT schedule/GO, app checks, A release and all eight-arm no-app preflight
stop chain on identity/cache/nice/quiet/process/timeout/observation/report-count failure; preserve actual receipt, no retries/replacement
stop chain after an ON transport/protocol refusal, missing footer, drops/invalid/clipped/capped/missing phase/binding/window failure; no eligible attribution from it
rare stalls and audio positives remain failures/observations under existing gates but do not adapt or extend this fixed diagnostic cohort; no suppressive stopping/rerun-until-clean
zero triggers is COMPLETE_NO_TRIGGER, not a diagnosed cause or evidence that stalls are fixed
